abilities.name: Frostmourne Hungers
abilities.text:
Activate to make Arthas's next Basic Attack strike immediately and deal 71 bonus damage. Dealing damage restores 40 Mana.

Quest: Killing a Minion or hitting a Hero with Frostmourne Hungers permanently increases its bonus damage by 3 and Arthas's Basic Attack damage by 0.75.

abilities.name: Death Coil
abilities.text:
Deals 164 damage to target enemy.

Can be self-cast to heal for 275 Health.

abilities.name: Howling Blast
abilities.text: Root enemies within the target area for 1.25 seconds and deals 68 damage.

abilities.name: Frozen Tempest
abilities.text: Deal 36 damage per second to nearby enemies and Slow them by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Frozen Tempest's effects last for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Army of the Dead
abilities.text:
Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 Health. Stores up to 6 charges.

Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Summon Sindragosa
abilities.text: Deals 230 damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

1.name: Frost Presence
1.text:
Increase the area of Howling Blast by 20%.

Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Howling Blast.

Reward: After Hitting 15 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20% and it hits enemies in its path.

Reward: After Hitting 30 Heroes, Death Coil Slows Heroes hit by 50% for 1.25 seconds.

1.name: Borean Winds
1.text:
After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed.

Passive: Frozen Tempest's Slowing effects last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.

1.name: Rime
1.text:
Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.

Passive: Arthas heals for 24 Health per second while Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

4.name: Shattered Armor
4.text: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

4.name: Icy Talons
4.text: Gain 3% Attack Speed for 2 seconds every time a Hero is damaged by Frozen Tempest, up to a maximum of 60%.

4.name: Frost Strike
4.text: Frostmourne Hungers deals an additional 115 Spell Damage in an area and Slows enemy Heroes hit by 20% for 2 seconds.

7.name: Immortal Coil
7.text: Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 75% bonus healing and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

7.name: Rune Tap
7.text:
Every 3rd Basic Attack heals Arthas for 5% of his max Health.

Passive: Each stack of Frostmourne Hungers increases Arthas's maximum Health by 10.

7.name: Icebound Fortitude
7.text:
Activate to instantly remove all Roots and Slows. Gain 25 Armor and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds.

Each Hero Rooted by Howling Blast reduces the cooldown of this ability by 2 seconds.

10.name: Army of the Dead
10.text:
Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 Health. Stores up to 6 charges.

Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

10.name: Summon Sindragosa
10.text: Deals 230 damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

13.name: Deathlord
13.text:
If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero.

Passive: Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, up to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.

13.name: Deathchill
13.text:
Howling Blast's damage is increased by 2 for each stack of Frostmourne Hungers.

Howling Blast deals 100% additional damage and Roots for an additional 0.25 seconds against Heroes under 50% Health.

13.name: Biting Cold
13.text: Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 15% bonus damage, up to a 75% bonus.

16.name: Remorseless Winter
16.text: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.

16.name: Frostmourne Feeds
16.text: Reduce the cooldown of Frostmourne Hungers by 6 seconds. Arthas heals for 75% of the Basic Attack damage dealt by Frostmourne Hungers.

16.name: Anti-Magic Shell
16.text: Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.

20.name: Legion of Northrend
20.text:
Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds.

Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.

20.name: Absolute Zero
20.text: Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.

20.name: Death Pact
20.text:
Instantly double your stacks of Frostmourne Hungers, but it no longer gains stacks from hitting Heroes or killing Minions.

Passive: Takedowns grant 2 stacks of Frostmourne Hungers.

20.name: Path of Frost
20.text:
Activate to instantly mount with 140% minimum Movement Speed. Taking damage does not dismount Arthas from this Mount. Lasts up to 5 seconds.

When Arthas dismounts, Slow all nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds and deal 66 damage.
